sources.title: Ingot - Subnet Alpha
sources.snippet: The starting point, Ingot-genesis-27B-FP8, was crowned on 16 October 2026, and by the morning of 17 October miners had already produced three kings (Ingot-I, Ingot-II and Ingot-III) from 26 evaluated submissions. Dashboard theingot.ai is the subnet's live dashboard.
